title: Resonance
description: A relation between positions on the SAME question. Never a claim that two texts mean the same thing — only that two readings answer one question similarly or oppositely, which is a far weaker and defensible claim. See docs/10-resonance.md.

claim.description: A CLOSED vocabulary, deliberately. There is no free-text field in which the system can assert that two traditions agree. This is the linguistic ceiling from docs/11-guardrails.md: the strongest thing the system may ever say is that two readings answer one question similarly.

divergence.description: REQUIRED, at least one, INCLUDING on resonances that record agreement. A recorded agreement that does not also record what it hides is syncretism, and this project does not ship it. This is the single most important constraint in the resonance model.
